nodes.description: Ownable._owner: address of the contract owner, controls privileged functions
INSICE._totalSupply: total fragment supply, mutated by rebase and constructor
INSICE._gonsPerFragment: conversion rate between gons and fragments
INSICE._gonBalances: mapping of address to internal gon balance
INSICE._allowedFragments: nested mapping of owner to spender allowances
constant TOTAL_GONS: maximum gon amount derived from MAX_UINT256
constant MAX_SUPPLY: upper bound (2^128)-1 clamped in rebase
constant INITIAL_FRAGMENTS_SUPPLY: 2,000,000 * 10^18 initial supply
SafeMath.add: checked addition helper
SafeMath.sub: checked subtraction helper with revert message
SafeMath.mul: checked multiplication helper
SafeMath.div: division helper reverting on zero divisor
SafeMath.mod: modulo helper reverting on zero divisor
Ownable constructor: sets _owner from msg.sender and emits ownership event
Ownable.owner: view returning the stored owner address
onlyOwner modifier: requires _owner == msg.sender before executing body
renounceOwnership: owner-gated function setting _owner to address(0)
transferOwnership: owner-gated function assigning a new owner address
validRecipient modifier: rejects address(0) and the token contract itself
rebase: owner-only supply adjuster recomputing _totalSupply and _gonsPerFragment
INSICE constructor: mints TOTAL_GONS to owner and sets initial rates
totalSupply: view returning _totalSupply
balanceOf: view converting gon balance to fragment balance
transfer: moves fragment value between callers using gon conversion
allowance: view returning spender allowance for an owner
transferFrom: spends allowance and moves fragments between accounts
approve: writes an allowance value for a spender
increaseAllowance: adds to the caller's allowance entry
decreaseAllowance: subtracts from the caller's allowance entry
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for ownership, balances and allowances
arithmetic: _totalSupply = _totalSupply.sub(supplyDelta) in rebase, unchecked direction of supply delta
arithmetic: _gonsPerFragment = TOTAL_GONS.div(_totalSupply) in rebase, reverts or misprices if _totalSupply is zero
arithmetic: _totalSupply clamp against MAX_SUPPLY after subtraction
access_control: require(_owner == msg.sender) gating rebase and ownership functions
arithmetic: value.mul(_gonsPerFragment) and gon balance sub/add in transfer
arithmetic: allowance subtraction plus gon balance sub/add in transferFrom
access_control: require(to != address(0)) and require(to != address(this)) in validRecipient
unrestricted allowance overwrite in approve without zero-first pattern
arithmetic: allowance add/subtract in increaseAllowance and decreaseAllowance
arithmetic: constructor supply/gon initialization and TOTAL_GONS.div(_totalSupply)
rebase parameter epoch, only emitted in the LogRebase event
rebase parameter supplyDelta, subtracted from _totalSupply
transfer parameter to, recipient address
transfer parameter value, fragment amount to move
balanceOf parameter who, queried address
allowance parameter owner_, allowance holder
allowance parameter spender, allowance beneficiary
transferFrom parameter from, debited account
transferFrom parameter to, credited account
transferFrom parameter value, fragment amount to move
approve parameter spender, allowance beneficiary
approve parameter value, allowance amount written
increaseAllowance parameter spender
increaseAllowance parameter addedValue
decreaseAllowance parameter spender
decreaseAllowance parameter subtractedValue
transferOwnership parameter newOwner, new privileged address
validRecipient modifier parameter to, address being validated
transfer local variable gonValue = value.mul(_gonsPerFragment)
transferFrom local variable gonValue = value.mul(_gonsPerFragment)
decreaseAllowance local variable oldValue holding current allowance
